info.title: ServiceGrid IQ implemented Phase 5 readiness and approval API
info.description: Local readiness, visit-bound manual evidence, deterministic dispatch-v2 ranking and atomic idempotent approval. Quantities are positive decimal strings with at most three decimal places. Part confirmation freshness is evaluated against server time (default 24 hours, owner range 1–168). Any material edit invalidates READY and warning acknowledgments; visit or requirement revisions invalidate corresponding evidence. Mandatory checks have no deletion/disable endpoint. Parts are not reserved, stock accounting is absent, and the transactional outbox is recorded but not delivered. See the Phase 5 design for limits and the Phase 3 intake contract for extended READY/ASSIGNED statuses.
